lines.zh: 我走过格瑞克的灰地，脚印是圆的。
lines.en: I cross Greck's ash fields leaving round prints.

lines.zh: 头太重，走路总往一边偏。
lines.en: My head is heavy, so I always lean to one side.

lines.zh: 这具身体没有皮，走起来很轻。
lines.en: There is no skin on this body, so walking is light.

lines.zh: 我踩在骨堆上，它们认得我。
lines.en: I step on bone piles, and they know me.

lines.zh: 一路走过，灰里露出半张脸。
lines.en: As I pass, half a face shows in the ash.

lines.zh: 我不跑，跑起来头会掉。
lines.en: I do not run; running shakes my head loose.

lines.zh: 这片地太软，走一步陷一指。
lines.en: The ground is soft; each step sinks a finger deep.

lines.zh: 我沿着旧车辙走，那是别人的路。
lines.en: I follow old wheel ruts that belonged to others.

lines.zh: 骨节相碰，替我在灰里打拍子。
lines.en: My joints click a rhythm through the ash.

lines.zh: 我慢慢移动，像一扇会走的门。
lines.en: I move slowly, like a walking door.

lines.zh: 身后那串印子，很快就填平了。
lines.en: The prints behind me fill in quickly.

lines.zh: 格瑞克的风推我，我顺着走。
lines.en: Greck's wind pushes me, and I go along.

lines.zh: 我站在灰里，等灰盖住脚。
lines.en: I stand in ash and let it cover my feet.

lines.zh: 一百一十八点生命，没人来试。
lines.en: One hundred eighteen points of life, untested.

lines.zh: 我的头骨里空着，风穿过去会响。
lines.en: My skull is hollow, and wind sings through it.

lines.zh: 格瑞克没有白天，只有浅一点的灰。
lines.en: Greck has no day, only thinner gray.

lines.zh: 我坐着，骨头慢慢和地长在一起。
lines.en: I sit until my bones knit into the ground.

lines.zh: 我想不起来自己原本的样子。
lines.en: I cannot recall what I looked like before.

lines.zh: 远处有敲击声，我不去管。
lines.en: Something knocks far away, and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我用手指在灰上画圈，再抹掉。
lines.en: I draw circles in ash, then wipe them out.

lines.zh: 没有皮肉，我也觉得冷。
lines.en: Without flesh, I still feel cold.

lines.zh: 安静时，我数骨头的接缝。
lines.en: In the quiet, I count the seams of my bones.

lines.zh: 你的脸很完整，让我多看一眼。
lines.en: Your face is intact, so let me look a while.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，不是认亲。
lines.en: I stare at you, and it is not kinship.

lines.zh: 你的皮还包着，真好。
lines.en: Your skin still wraps you. How nice.

lines.zh: 我在找你的头骨，位置很显眼。
lines.en: I am locating your skull; it sits quite plainly.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的动作，我已经忘了。
lines.en: The way you blink is something I have forgotten.

lines.zh: 别低头，我想看清你的颈椎。
lines.en: Do not bow; I want to see your neck.

lines.zh: 你身上有热气，我这里没有。
lines.en: You give off heat, and nothing here does.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，是因为脖子接错了。
lines.en: My head tilts because my neck is joined wrong.

lines.zh: 你带了火把，灰地会认得你。
lines.en: You carry a torch, so the ash will remember you.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛还在动，我很羡慕。
lines.en: Your eyes still move, and I envy that.

lines.zh: 疼，可我没有血可以流。
lines.en: It hurts, but I have no blood to spill.

lines.zh: 你打断了一根，我照样站。
lines.en: You broke one, and I still stand.

lines.zh: 这一下让我歪得更厉害。
lines.en: That knocked me further out of line.

lines.zh: 我的骨头很旧，敲起来很脆。
lines.en: My bones are old and ring brittle when struck.

lines.zh: 别打头，那是唯一完整的部分。
lines.en: Not the head; it is the only intact part.

lines.zh: 伤口对我不算什么，反正没有皮。
lines.en: Wounds mean little to me; I have no skin.

lines.zh: 你听见的碎裂声，是我借来的骨头。
lines.en: The crack you heard was a borrowed bone.

lines.zh: 我退开，只是为了一块新骨头。
lines.en: I pull back only to find a new bone.

lines.zh: 疼过之后，我就记不住疼了。
lines.en: After the pain passes, I forget it.

lines.zh: 这一下，我会从你身上补回来。
lines.en: I will make up for that from your body.

lines.zh: 我张不开嘴，下颌是断的。
lines.en: I cannot open my mouth; my jaw is broken.

lines.zh: 食物会穿过我，落在地上。
lines.en: Food would pass through me and hit the floor.

lines.zh: 你举着肉，我只看见骨头。
lines.en: You hold up meat, and I only see the bone.

lines.zh: 我没有胃，收不了你的好意。
lines.en: I have no stomach to receive your kindness.

lines.zh: 别喂我，灰已经够我吃了。
lines.en: Do not feed me; I have eaten enough ash.

lines.zh: 那味道太浓，我退后一点。
lines.en: That smell is too strong, so I step back.

lines.zh: 我追你，不是为了吃。
lines.en: I come after you, but not to eat.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，我只要会动的东西。
lines.en: Put it away; I want things that still move.

lines.zh: 上一次有人喂我，手被我拿走了。
lines.en: The last one who fed me lost a hand.

lines.zh: 你的面包在我眼里，和灰一样。
lines.en: Your bread looks like ash to me.

lines.zh: 骨头撞骨头，我们都听得懂。
lines.en: Bone against bone, and we both understand it.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我身上的灰全扬了。
lines.en: You rammed me, and the ash flew off my bones.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的头会磕到你。
lines.en: Not so close; my head will knock against yours.

lines.zh: 我退半步，灰地上多两个印。
lines.en: I step back, leaving two more prints.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的肋骨错位了。
lines.en: That collision knocked a rib out of line.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我的颧骨上。
lines.en: Your shoulder struck my cheekbone.

lines.zh: 我们相撞时，声音像敲空罐。
lines.en: When we collide, it sounds like empty pots.

lines.zh: 你从侧面挤，我的骨头顶回去。
lines.en: Push from the side and my bones push back.

lines.zh: 别踩我的脚趾，那是我借的。
lines.en: Do not step on my toes; those are borrowed.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，我的头歪得更厉害。
lines.en: After the impact my head tilts worse than before.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，生不出什么。
lines.en: In this state I could not produce anything.

lines.zh: 格瑞克的同类见面，只点头骨。
lines.en: Kin in Greck only nod their skulls at each other.

lines.zh: 没有血肉，谈不上亲近。
lines.en: Without flesh, closeness is not a thing.

lines.zh: 我曾经有过伴，后来成了我的骨头。
lines.en: I had a companion once, and he became my bones.

lines.zh: 别问这个，我的胸腔是空的。
lines.en: Do not ask; my chest is empty.

lines.zh: 两具骨架相靠，只会互相刮响。
lines.en: Two frames pressed together only scrape.

lines.zh: 我在等一具完整的身体，不是伴侣。
lines.en: I wait for a whole body, not a partner.

lines.zh: 繁殖是活人的事，我早已退出。
lines.en: Breeding is for the living, and I left that behind.

lines.zh: 同类之间，我们分享灰。
lines.en: Among kin we share nothing but ash.

lines.zh: 我的骨头太旧，接不出新的。
lines.en: My bones are too old to make new ones.

lines.zh: 地上有根指骨，正好补右手。
lines.en: A finger bone on the ground fits my right hand.

lines.zh: 我捡起头骨，看了看，扔了。
lines.en: I pick up a skull, look at it, and drop it.

lines.zh: 铁我不要，铁在灰里太亮。
lines.en: I do not take iron; it shines too bright in ash.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的人，我都记得。
lines.en: Everyone who fell here, I remember.

lines.zh: 我捡的不是东西，是零件。
lines.en: What I gather is not loot but spare parts.

lines.zh: 那根骨头太细，撑不住我。
lines.en: That bone is too thin to hold me up.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进肋骨，走路会响。
lines.en: I tuck things between ribs, and they rattle.

lines.zh: 这枚戒指有什么用？我戴不上。
lines.en: A ring? What use is it? My fingers are gone.

lines.zh: 灰底下的东西，我用手摸。
lines.en: I feel under the ash with my fingers.

lines.zh: 我收好它，也许以后能换骨头。
lines.en: I keep it; someday it may buy me bone.

lines.zh: 你进了灰地，就是我的东西。
lines.en: You stepped into the ash, so now you are mine.

lines.zh: 我闻到热气，那是活人的味道。
lines.en: I smell warmth, and warmth means the living.

lines.zh: 一百一十八点生命，换你一条命。
lines.en: One hundred eighteen points, traded for your life.

lines.zh: 别回头看，我的头已经转过来。
lines.en: Do not look back; my head has already turned.

lines.zh: 这片灰地上，只有你和我的脚印。
lines.en: On this ash field there are only your prints and mine.

lines.zh: 你先动的手，还是我先看的你？
lines.en: Did you swing first, or did I look first?

lines.zh: 目标很简单：会走路的身体。
lines.en: The target is simple: a body that still walks.

lines.zh: 你身上的骨头，比这里的整齐。
lines.en: The bones in you are neater than the ones here.

lines.zh: 我锁住你时，风会停一下。
lines.en: When I lock on, the wind pauses once.

lines.zh: 格瑞克的规矩：先站住，再倒下。
lines.en: Greck's rule: first stand, then fall.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声太干净，这里没有。
lines.en: Your footsteps are too clean for this place.

lines.zh: 我看见你的影子已经很长了。
lines.en: I see your shadow has already grown long.

lines.zh: 别跑了，灰地有多大我知道。
lines.en: Stop running; I know how far the ash goes.

lines.zh: 来了个带着皮肉的，好久没有。
lines.en: One with flesh and skin, first in a long while.

lines.zh: 灰地上的风转了向，是你
lines.en: The wind on the ash changed direction; that is you.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚印，一步不差。
lines.en: I follow your prints without missing one.

lines.zh: 你往哪走，我的头就往哪偏。
lines.en: Wherever you go, my head tilts that way.

lines.zh: 别爬石头，我的手指会挖。
lines.en: Do not climb the rocks; my fingers dig.

lines.zh: 你喘气的声音，在灰里传得远。
lines.en: Your breathing carries far through the ash.

lines.zh: 我迈得慢，可我从没停过。
lines.en: My strides are slow, yet I have never halted.

lines.zh: 你的火把灭了，那就更好找。
lines.en: Your torch went out, which makes you easier.

lines.zh: 我一直朝你的方向歪着头。
lines.en: I keep my head tilted toward you.

lines.zh: 距离在缩短，你没发觉吧。
lines.en: The distance is closing, and you have not noticed.

lines.zh: 你躲在骨堆后面，骨头告诉我了。
lines.en: You hid behind the bone pile, and the bones told me.

lines.zh: 这地方没有回声，除了你的。
lines.en: Nothing echoes here except you.

lines.zh: 我不着急，灰地很大，你不快。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the ash is wide and you are slow.

lines.zh: 你的方向我记下了，改不了。
lines.en: I have your heading, and it cannot change.

lines.zh: 只要你还站着，我就跟着。
lines.en: As long as you stand, I follow.

lines.zh: 我绕过去，在前面等你。
lines.en: I will go around and wait ahead of you.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，看看你的脚
lines.en: I lower my head to study your feet.

lines.zh: 你绕了一圈，还在我的视线里
lines.en: You circled once and are still in my sight.

lines.zh: 我不跑，我走，走得稳
lines.en: I do not run; I walk, steadily.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，也有汗味
lines.en: You smell of iron and of sweat.

lines.zh: 十二点，一下就能撕开皮。
lines.en: Twelve points, enough to open skin.

lines.zh: 我的指骨钩住你的袖子。
lines.en: My finger bones hook into your sleeve.

lines.zh: 别挡脸，我先要脖子。
lines.en: Do not cover your face; I want the neck first.

lines.zh: 这一抓，你会记很久。
lines.en: This scratch will stay with you a while.

lines.zh: 我没有爪子，骨头就够尖。
lines.en: I have no claws, but bone is sharp enough.

lines.zh: 你倒下的地方，我早就看好了。
lines.en: I picked the spot where you will fall.

lines.zh: 我的手臂不长，但很沉。
lines.en: My arms are short, but they are heavy.

lines.zh: 别退，退了我会追得更紧。
lines.en: Do not retreat; it only pulls me closer.

lines.zh: 打中你时，我听见骨头在应。
lines.en: When I hit you, I hear your bones answer.

lines.zh: 这一抓，你的护腕裂了缝。
lines.en: That swipe opened a crack in your bracer.

lines.zh: 我不用喊，喊了也没人听。
lines.en: I do not shout; nobody listens anyway.

lines.zh: 灰落进你的伤口，很疼吧。
lines.en: Ash falls into your wound; that stings, yes?

lines.zh: 再来一下，你的膝盖就软了。
lines.en: One more and your knees will fold.

lines.zh: 我打你时，自己也掉了两块。
lines.en: When I strike, two of my own pieces fall.

lines.zh: 这一爪从肩到肋
lines.en: This claw goes from shoulder to ribs.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的盾沿，往下拽
lines.en: I catch your shield rim and pull down.

lines.zh: 我从格瑞克的灰里抬起头骨。
lines.en: I raise my skull out of Greck's ash.

lines.zh: 一百一十八点生命，够撑一场。
lines.en: One hundred eighteen points will last one fight.

lines.zh: 谁把骨头堆在这里，正好是我。
lines.en: Someone stacked bones here, and they fit me.

lines.zh: 我又站起来了，还是没人来。
lines.en: I am standing again, and still nobody comes.

lines.zh: 灰太厚，我先抖一抖。
lines.en: The ash is thick, so let me shake it off.

lines.zh: 这具身体不太合身，但能走。
lines.en: This body does not fit well, but it walks.

lines.zh: 脚下的骨头在动，它们在让位。
lines.en: The bones underfoot shift aside for me.

lines.zh: 格瑞克的夜又长又灰。
lines.en: Night in Greck is long and gray.

lines.zh: 我醒来第一件事，是找脸。
lines.en: First thing on waking, I look for a face.

lines.zh: 我的头骨裂缝里还塞着旧土。
lines.en: Old soil still packs the cracks in my skull.

lines.zh: 站起来时，我听见自己散了一下。
lines.en: Standing up, I hear myself come apart slightly.

lines.zh: 又一副身体，又一场空。
lines.en: Another body, and another empty hunt.

lines.zh: 这片灰地记得我，每次都记得。
lines.en: This ash field remembers me, every time.

lines.zh: 睁开眼不容易，我没有眼皮。
lines.en: Opening my eyes is hard; I have no lids.

lines.zh: 火烧不到肉，只能烤我的骨头。
lines.en: Fire finds no flesh, only my bone to scorch.

lines.zh: 落下来时，我的头先着地。
lines.en: Falling, my head lands first.

lines.zh: 水从眼窝进去，从下颌漏出来。
lines.en: Water enters my sockets and leaks out my jaw.

lines.zh: 炸起来的时候，我散得挺开。
lines.en: When it blew, I scattered quite well.

lines.zh: 箭卡在我的颧骨上，拔不出来。
lines.en: The arrow is stuck in my cheekbone.

lines.zh: 魔法在我骨头里转，像虫在爬。
lines.en: Magic crawls through my bones like insects.

lines.zh: 我早就不吃东西，饿不到我。
lines.en: I stopped eating long ago, so hunger misses me.

lines.zh: 雷照亮了灰地，也照亮了我。
lines.en: Lightning lit the ash field, and lit me too.

lines.zh: 虚空把我吞下去，连骨头都不剩。
lines.en: The void swallows me, leaving not even bone.
